title: Work the needs-attention list
caption: Dashboard counts and the bookings list's saved views ask the API the same question (bookings/views.ts).

steps.title: Read the dashboard
steps.body: Look at the three counts and the authorised payments.
steps.expect: A count that is not 0 is amber; "10,000+" for a `null` total; a failed tile shows its own error and request id.

steps.title: Open the view
steps.body: Click a count (e.g. Ticketing failed or in manual review).
steps.expect: `/bookings` with the view marked and the same total; rows with reference, locator, lead traveller, status, ticketing + deadline, payment, total with net and markup.

steps.title: Narrow and page
steps.body: Add a filter (Channel = Imported) and go to the next page.
steps.expect: The URL holds every filter and `cursor`; **First page** drops the cursor; a deadline view keeps `asOf`.

steps.title: Open a booking
steps.expect: **What needs staff** names the reason; Booking actions match the permissions and `consoleActions`.

steps.title: Act and check
steps.body: Issue, cancel or resync, then go back to the view.
steps.expect: The booking left the view; the dashboard count dropped by one.
